definitions.abet: (usu. aid and abet) encourage or assist (someone) to do something wrong, in particular to commit a crime.
definitions.able: having the power, skill, or means to do something.
definitions.alibi: a claim or piece of evidence that one was elsewhere when an alleged act took place.
definitions.arbiter: a person who settles a dispute.
definitions.bail: the temporary release of an accused person awaiting trial, sometimes on condition that a sum of money is lodged to guarantee their appearance in court.
definitions.bait: food used to entice fish or other animals as prey.
definitions.bale: a large wrapped or bound bundle of paper, hay, or cotton.
definitions.bare: (of a person or part of the body) not clothed or covered.
definitions.barre: a horizontal bar at waist level used as a support by ballet dancers during certain exercises.
definitions.barrel: a cylindrical container bulging out in the middle, traditionally made of wooden staves enclosed by metal hoops.
definitions.barter: exchange (goods or services) for other goods or services.
definitions.beat: strike (a person or an animal) repeatedly and violently so as to hurt or punish them.
definitions.belt: a strip of leather or other material worn round the waist to support or hold in clothes or to carry weapons.
definitions.beta: the second letter of the Greek alphabet (Β, β), transliterated as ‘b’.
definitions.bier: a movable platform on which a coffin or corpse is placed before burial.
definitions.bile: a bitter greenish-brown alkaline fluid secreted by the liver and stored in the gall bladder, which aids digestion.
definitions.bite: use the teeth to cut into something.
definitions.bleat: (of a sheep or goat) make a characteristic weak, wavering cry.
definitions.briar: a prickly scrambling shrub, especially a wild rose.
definitions.rarebit: a dish of melted and seasoned cheese on toast.
definitions.table: a piece of furniture with a flat top and one or more legs, providing a level surface for eating, writing, or working at.
definitions.tibia: the inner and typically larger of the two bones between the knee and the ankle, parallel with the fibula.
definitions.tribal: of or characteristic of a tribe or tribes.
definitions.tribe: a social division in a traditional society consisting of linked families or communities with a common culture and dialect.
